reviews.comment: Great intro to AI. Professor Ioerger didn't give the most interesting lectures. The class is heavy on exams when it comes to weighting. The exam material is from the slides, but there were around 250 slides of material covered in the final exam and nearly all topics were included in the exam. He does curve at the end.

The class is very fun and one of the more interesting classes I took. Fantastic intro to AI. We learn about fascinating topics and do fun projects. Course expectations are very clear, but there aren't a lot of this the class is graded by. Very test heavy, 2 tests were worth 55% of the grade. Test is memorization heavy too but straight from slides

loved this class! extremely fair grading, tests are very reasonable and heavily based off of lecture material, and the lectures are super understandable. your grade is heavily based off of midterm and non-comprehensive final. programming assignments were fun and had clear requirements. hws are pretty much designed to help you understand material.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ioerger is a great guy and a knowledgeable professor. The class itself is very interesting and you will learn a lot if you attend the lectures and pay attention. Programming assignments are actually interesting (unlike other classes) and not too difficult at all. Exams are basically just a regurgitation of information, so keep that in mind.

121 Honors with him. Attendance is optional but I learned a lot in class (contrary to most other classes). Very helpful and accessible during office hours. He is very considerate grader. He prorates point deductions over time (1 hour late does not equal 1 day late). Not easy ofc but very doable!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great guy, passionate about the subject material and had good rapport with the students. Sometimes moves too quickly when introducing topics from scratch (esp for CSCE 121), but I felt that I had a good grasp of each concept by the time the tests rolled around even though I didn't have too much previous programming experience.

Awesome AI course. Lectures could be slow but only because he wants to be very clear. Super interesting and very fun projects - especially the last couple. Easy A if you go to class and pay attn. Don't bother with the book unless you're really lost. Learned a lot and it was fun. No group projects, no quizzes. Just 6 projects and 2 simple exams.
